summary: The non-vanishing constant term localises the frequency T on the lattice (zeroTermFin_support); reading the relation between the two lattice bases entrywise along the string gives one integrality per string index of Y′ (claim H), which with hb, hx, ha and hg is the near-lines bound with k + 1.

steps.claim: Unpack hx: an adapted basis B at x_f with diagonal γ and the bounds (p), and substitute s = s′ + 1 and m.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨B, γ, p, _⟩, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx, hs, hm

steps.claim: Choose an adapted basis B′ at x′_f with diagonal γ′ (q).
steps.lean: peel Y'.exists_isAdaptedAt x'.2 with B' γ' q

steps.claim: Claim H (proved from step 7 on): for every string index i of Y′, c^{[s′ odd ⟺ i ≤ s′−1−i]}·conj(b/γ_{rev(i)+1})/α/γ′_i ∈ Ô.
steps.lean:
have H i : ite (Odd s' ↔ i ≤ Fin.rev i) Y.c.1 1 • (star (b / γ i.rev.succ) / α /
    γ' i).1 ∈ Ô E := ?_
steps.typed_fact:
ite (Odd s' ↔ i ≤ Fin.rev i) Y.c.1 1 • (star (b / γ i.rev.succ) / α /
    γ' i).1 ∈ Ô E

steps.claim: Translate H and the hypotheses into inequalities of ideleLogVal at every place.
steps.lean: simp [apply_ite ideleLogVal, ↓ite_smul, ite_mem, mem_Ô, smul_def] at *; unfold ideleLogVal at *

steps.claim: Use v(c) = v(aā) (ha) and expand the absolute values.
steps.lean: simp [ha, ← log_le_log, ← ideleLogVal.eq_1, abs_le] at *

steps.claim: The near-lines bound for γ′ with m′ and k + 1 follows from H, hx, hb and hg (linear inequalities, grind).
steps.lean: grind [star_star]

steps.claim: Choose the splitting D of Hom(V, V′) along the maps of positive degree, with the constant-term formula L and the projection formula P (exists_splitting_constTerm).
steps.lean: choose _ _ _ D _ P L using Y.exists_splitting_constTerm Y'.gradeOf_stringReversal

steps.claim: Let g be the finite component of (x, x′) acting on Hom(V, V′).
steps.lean: let g := (G.onHom (x, x')).2

steps.claim: The constant term of t ⊗ f at (x, x′) is non-zero (n), so zeroTermFin(D)(ϱ_f(T)ω(g)f) ≠ 0; ω(g)f is fixed by ϱ_f(b·g·y), y ∈ Ô (hf); so zeroTermFin_support (M = b·g, M′ = b̄⁻¹·g) gives l ∈ Ô with k_fᴴ(T − M′l) = 0 (e).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨l, hl, e⟩ := zeroTermFin_support D (b.1 • g) (star b⁻¹.1 • g) (n <| by
    simp [L, pairWeil, omega_integrated]; rw [((zeroTermFin_spec D).2 ..).choose_spec, ·]
    simp) (by simp [← U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose]) (by simpa using congrArg (ω _ g) <| hf · ·)

steps.claim: Rewrite e in matrix coordinates:
steps.lean:
rw [show _ᴴ = (D.kᴴ * (V.hom V').J).map (algebraMap _ (𝔸f E)) * (V.hom V').xFin.1 by
    simp [← gram_inv_of_gram_eq gram_xFin, Splitting.kAdelic, ← RingHom.coe_snd]
    congr with; simp, ← mulVec_mulVec, (rfl : (xFin _).1 = V'.xFin ⊗ₖ V.xFin⁻¹.1ᵀ),
    finCoord_homAtPoint, G.onHom_snd, smul_mulVec, mulVec_sub, mulVec_smul] at e

steps.claim: the adjoint of the adelic frame k equals (Dᴴ·J_Hom)·x_f(Hom) (the frame in coordinates);
steps.lean:
show _ᴴ = (D.kᴴ * (V.hom V').J).map (algebraMap _ (𝔸f E)) * (V.hom V').xFin.1 by
    simp [← gram_inv_of_gram_eq gram_xFin, Splitting.kAdelic, ← RingHom.coe_snd]
    congr with; simp

steps.claim: and the frame of Hom(V, V′) is x′_f ⊗ (x_f⁻¹)ᵀ, applied to the coordinates of T.
steps.lean:
, ← mulVec_mulVec, (rfl : (xFin _).1 = V'.xFin ⊗ₖ V.xFin⁻¹.1ᵀ),
    finCoord_homAtPoint, G.onHom_snd, smul_mulVec, mulVec_sub, mulVec_smul] at e

steps.claim: For indices i of V′ and j of V with grade_{Y′}(i) < grade_Y(j), e gives an identity between the (i, j) entry of b̄·W and the corresponding entry built from l.
steps.lean:
have h i j (h : Y'.gradeOf i < Y.gradeOf j) := by
    simpa [← Matrix.map_mul, ↓P, matToVec, ↓vecToMat_matToVec, coe_units_inv, ← mul_assoc,
      ← star_mul, mul_sub, h, ↓kronecker_mulVec_eq_matToVec] using congr(star b *
      (((V.hom V').J⁻¹ * D.k).map (↑) *ᵥ $e) (i, j))

steps.claim: Name W the matrix x′_f·(the point of Hom).
steps.lean: generalize o : V'.xFin.1 * (_ : Matrix ι' ι (𝔸f E)) = W at h

steps.claim: B′⁻¹·W·(J⁻¹·B⁻¹ᴴ) is integral (B′ and B adapted, l integral), and H is its entry at (string i of Y′, string rev(i) + 1 of Y); reduce H to this entry.
steps.lean:
convert (by simpa [← o, coe_units_inv, ← U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose, inv_eq_left_inv gram_xFin,
    ← Matrix.map_mul, ← (V.J.map _).mul_assoc] using (q.2.isIntMatrix.mul (N :=
    vecToMat l) (hl ⟨·, ·⟩)).mul p.2.isIntMatrix.isInt_conjTranspose : IsIntMatrix _ (B'⁻¹.1 * W *
    (V.J⁻¹.map (↑) * B⁻¹.1ᴴ))) (Y'.indexEquiv (.inr i)) (Y.indexEquiv (.inr i.rev.succ))

steps.claim: Simplify step 11 with the string maps.
steps.lean: clear * - h p q; simp [stringMap, reindex_equiv Y.indexEquiv, reindex_equiv Y'.indexEquiv] at h

steps.claim: Expand the entry as a double sum.
steps.lean: simp only [Y.J_inv_eq_gradedGram, ↓map_gradedGram_mul_apply, mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]

steps.claim: Only the term (string castSucc(i) of Y, string i of Y′) survives, by the triangularity of B⁻¹ and B′⁻¹.
steps.lean:
rw [← sum_prod_type', sum_eq_single (Y.indexEquiv (.inr i.castSucc), Y'.indexEquiv (.inr i)) (by
    simp [reindex_equiv Y.indexEquiv, reindex_equiv Y'.indexEquiv, stringReversal]
    grind (splits := 20) [p.inv, q.inv, IsAdaptedBasis, BlockTriangular, flagOrder, star_zero])]

steps.claim: Compute this term with step 11.
steps.lean: simp [stringReversal, algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← h.2]

steps.claim: Conclude with N̄ = N and the diagonals γ⁻¹, γ′⁻¹ of B⁻¹, B′⁻¹.
steps.lean: grind [Y.N_spec, p.inv.3, q.inv.3, Pi.inv_apply]
